name: WhiteOak Capital Dividend Yield Fund - Regular Plan - Growth
fundManager: Ramesh Mantri, Trupti Agrawal, Dheeresh Pathak, Piyush Baranwal, Ashish Agrawal
objective: The primary objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation and regular income by investing predominantly in a well-diversified portfolio of equity and equity related instruments of dividend yielding companies.
